parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  query: `
    SELECT
      customer.id,
      customer.descriptive_name,
      campaign.id,
      campaign.name,
      segments.date,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks,
      metrics.cost_micros,
      metrics.conversions
    FROM campaign
    WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '${$('Get Req. Dates').first().json.date_from}'
      AND '${$('Get Req. Dates').first().json.date_to}'
  `
}
}}
